Clear the work folder | id: - | if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted' | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 2
actions/checkout | id: - | if: - | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: -
Copy the hub | id: - | if: - | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 1
Find the toolchain | id: toolchain | if: inputs.code-stage | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 1
Set up Node | id: - | if: inputs.code-stage | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 5
Install sandbox tools | id: - | if: inputs.code-stage && runner.environment == 'github-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux' | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 5
Install Claude Code | id: - | if: runner.environment == 'github-hosted' | env: CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 3
Fetch ticket | id: start | if: - | env: JIRA_DOMAIN,JIRA_EMAIL,JIRA_API_TOKEN,AGENT_HUB_GITHUB_TOKEN,AGENT_HUB_CI_TOKEN | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 3
Install dependencies | id: install | if: inputs.code-stage && steps.start.outputs.proceed == 'true' | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 15
Agent (draft and review) | id: agent | if: steps.start.outputs.proceed == 'true' | env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | continue-on-error: false | timeout: ${{ inputs.agent-minutes }}
Verify | id: verify | if: inputs.code-stage && steps.agent.outputs.status == 'ready' | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 30
Review | id: review | if: inputs.code-stage && steps.verify.outcome == 'success' | env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | continue-on-error: true | timeout: ${{ inputs.review-minutes }}
Fix | id: fix | if: inputs.code-stage && steps.review.outcome == 'success' | env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | continue-on-error: true | timeout: ${{ inputs.fix-minutes }}
Verify fix | id: verify-fix | if: inputs.code-stage && steps.fix.outcome == 'success' | env: - | continue-on-error: true | timeout: 30
Apply to ticket | id: apply | if: steps.agent.outputs.status == 'ready' | env: JIRA_DOMAIN,JIRA_EMAIL,JIRA_API_TOKEN,AGENT_HUB_GITHUB_TOKEN,AGENT_HUB_CI_TOKEN | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 3
Send back | id: return | if: steps.agent.outputs.status != '' && steps.agent.outputs.status != 'ready' | env: JIRA_DOMAIN,JIRA_EMAIL,JIRA_API_TOKEN | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 3
Record Claude usage | id: - | if: always() | env: JIRA_DOMAIN,JIRA_EMAIL,JIRA_API_TOKEN | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 2
Clear progress comment | id: - | if: success() || cancelled() | env: JIRA_DOMAIN,JIRA_EMAIL,JIRA_API_TOKEN | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 2
Report failure on ticket | id: - | if: failure() | env: JIRA_DOMAIN,JIRA_EMAIL,JIRA_API_TOKEN | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 2
Remove session and credential files | id: - | if: always() | env: - | continue-on-error: false | timeout: 1
